This '''school''' was a teaching site on the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Aing-Tii homeworld|homeworld]]. It was here that the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Tadar'Ro]] taught [[Jorj Car'das]] about the culture of the Aing-Tii [[Species/Legends|species]]. Later, after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] traveled here and was taught several [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|techniques]]&mdash;including [[flow-walking]]&mdash;from Tadar'Ro. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Tadar'Ro taught [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], [[Fold space|teleportation]] and flow-walking techniques.
